dataset_role: prospectively reserved one-shot independent wearable-EEG external replication of frozen DCS-OPCT v11
scientific_scope: cross-dataset, cross-device, and cross-channel-count transfer to independently collected four-channel Muse EEG during shared affective videos

source.article: Saganowski et al., Scientific Data 9, 158 (2022), doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01262-0
source.access_condition: academic use under the official EULA; signed EULA sent from an academic email associated with the Harvard Dataverse account
source.expected_public_scale: 43 participants, ten shared stimulus videos, four-channel Muse EEG sampled at 256 Hz

relationship_to_amigos.reporting_rule: Every acquired and executed one-shot dataset is reported, including ineligibility, abstention, null, or harmful outcomes.
relationship_to_amigos.dataset_specific_claim: A passing dataset may support a prospective dataset-specific external result.
relationship_to_amigos.replication_claim: Replicated external effectiveness may be claimed only if both AMIGOS and Emognition are acquired, endpoint-eligible, release non-identity actions, and independently pass every frozen effectiveness and non-harm requirement.
relationship_to_amigos.unavailable_dataset_rule: An acquisition failure is reported as an acquisition failure and supplies no effectiveness or safety evidence.

cohort_contract.participants: all 43 publicly described participant identifiers are attempted
cohort_contract.stimulus_trials: the ten STIMULUS-phase videos; BASELINE, WASHOUT, and QUESTIONNAIRES phases are excluded from the primary endpoint
cohort_contract.participant_task_requirements: at least one high and one low label, all four registered EEG channels, and at least three valid four-second windows in every retained trial
cohort_contract.exclusions: only absent or unreadable registered files, missing phase boundaries, absent registered channels, nonfinite signal, unusable Muse contact-quality status under the locked schema adapter, midpoint questionnaire label, or fewer than three valid analysis windows; no exclusion based on identity encoding, classifier accuracy, material events, risk score, calibration action, or certificate
cohort_contract.hard_failure: stop before model fitting for a task if fewer than 30 participants meet its locked requirements

task_contract.label_source: post-stimulus Self-Assessment Manikin response on the published nine-point scale
task_contract.label_rule: high if rating >= 6, low if rating <= 4, and rating 5 excluded as the scale midpoint
task_contract.forbidden_relabeling: no sample median, prevalence target, stimulus identity, model output, performance, or calibration-dependent thresholding
task_contract.claim_boundary: The tasks concern self-reported experienced affect and are not interchangeable with fixed intended-stimulus quadrants.

trial_contract.stimulus_identity: the ten published stimulus categories shared across participants
trial_contract.pseudoreplication_rule: one aggregate feature vector per participant-video pair; windows, samples, and device packets are not independent trials

feature_contract.construction: STIMULUS-phase raw channels, common-average reference, four-second windows with two-second step, linear detrending, Welch PSD, fixed band integration, and mean/population-SD/least-squares-slope summaries identical to the frozen-equivalent AMIGOS/FACED feature core
feature_contract.baseline_policy: baseline is not used in the primary one-shot representation; any baseline-referenced analysis is explicitly post-primary exploratory and cannot change the registered action or claim
feature_contract.unavailable_representation_policy: hard failure rather than channel substitution or feature replacement

dcs_opct_v11_contract.one_shot_rule: the first locked complete execution is the only confirmatory Emognition analysis; later cohort, label, quality, channel, seed, fold, feature, or baseline variants are exploratory

acceptance_gate.endpoint_eligibility: both audit and held-out partitions contain at least one material event and one non-event; otherwise discrimination and calibration effectiveness are non-estimable
acceptance_gate.effectiveness: a non-identity action is applicable, independently certified, and has held-out Brier gain greater than 0.001
acceptance_gate.released_action_nonharm: held-out Brier gain is nonnegative, held-out AUROC delta is at least -0.02, rank is at least 0.999999, and order inversions equal zero
acceptance_gate.identity_fallback: identity is non-intervention and is not evidence of effectiveness or safety success
acceptance_gate.failure_policy: all acquisition, structural, construction, endpoint-eligibility, applicability, certification, effectiveness, and non-harm failures remain reportable and immutable

execution_order: validate this reservation and the unchanged v11 freeze
obtain written EULA authorization and download only the official study archive
write and hash a file-name, byte-size, checksum, and container-schema manifest before parsing participant values
implement and test the schema-specific adapter on synthetic fixtures
parse participant, trial, questionnaire, quality, and EEG values once
run the registered feature construction and counterfactual experiment once
write and hash the unlabeled action and audit assignment before attaching material-event outcomes
apply frozen DCS-OPCT v11 once and preserve every outcome
claim_boundary: This reservation authorizes a future one-shot Emognition evaluation. It does not assert archive access, structural eligibility, endpoint variation, applicability, effectiveness, non-harm, safety, or replicated confirmation.
